profile.headline: Software Engineer at Jump Trading LLC

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description:
Certified by the CRLA (College Reading and Learning Association)
Helped peers on a regular basis to promote success in technical classes such as calculus and physics

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Conducted research on isogeometric analysis and NURBS meshes - specifically with the MFEM software package from Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory - in Carnegie Mellon's Computational Bio-Modeling Lab

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
Worked extensively with Common Object Request Broker Architecture (CORBA) specifications and implementations for use on the Boeing AWACS platform
Developed specialized process management software from scratch for the coordination of CORBA client and server threads in both Ada and C++
Researched file system server failover solutions for mission critical software
